title: A Rash Assumption · historical humour excerpt
instructions: 真人历史作品朗读，非现代场景对话或官方试卷。先独立听音并完成6题，再提交核对；录制署名不出题。级别只是编写目标，未做真实考生难度标定。来源与署名可在开始后查看；若打开外部全文或原音，后续继续按已见材料记录。
transcript:
On the morning of November 27th I awoke to find my chest covered with a pretty pink pattern. It blended so well with the colour of my pyjama-jacket that for some minutes I was lost in admiration of the pleasing effect. Then it occurred to me that coming diseases cast their rashes before them, and I sprang from the bed in an agony of apprehension. I rushed to the mirror and opened my mouth to look at my tongue. There it was. I took some of it out. It looked quite healthy, so I put it back again. Then I gazed long and earnestly down my throat. It was quite hollow as usual. Next I got the clinical thermometer and sucked it for quite a long time. When I removed it I saw my temperature was about 86. Then I found I was reading it upside down and that I was only normal. I felt disappointed. After that I tried my pulse. It took me some time to locate it, but it hadn't run down; it was still going quite regularly—andante ma non troppo, two beats in the bar. I whistled "Tipperary" to it, and it kept perfect time.
But still the rash remained. It would neither get out nor get under. I felt perfectly well, and yet I knew I must be ill. I could not understand the complete absence of other symptoms.

questions.prompt: What colour was the pattern on the narrator’s chest? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: my chest covered with a pretty pink pattern
questions.explanation: pink 修饰胸前图案；不是让考生诊断疾病。

questions.prompt: Why did the narrator first admire the pattern?
options: It reminded him of a picture.
It matched the colour of his nightclothes.
answers: It matched the colour of his nightclothes.
questions.evidence: It blended so well with the colour of my pyjama-jacket
questions.explanation: blended ... colour 解释最初欣赏图案的原因；后来才担心生病。

questions.prompt: What did he conclude when he looked at his tongue?
questions.evidence: It looked quite healthy, so I put it back again.
questions.explanation: healthy 是明确判断；没有深色或肿胀的描述。

questions.prompt: Why was the first temperature reading misleading?
options: He held the scale the wrong way up.
He forgot to wait before reading it.
answers: He held the scale the wrong way up.
questions.evidence: Then I found I was reading it upside down and that I was only normal.
questions.explanation: upside down 说明读数方向错误，随后发现体温正常。

questions.evidence: it was still going quite regularly—andante ma non troppo, two beats in the bar.
questions.explanation: regularly 与后面的音乐比喻都说明节律整齐，不是停跳或不断加快。

questions.prompt: What puzzled him at the end of the excerpt?
options: He could not remember how to use the mirror.
He felt well despite believing he was ill.
He could no longer see the pattern.
answers: He felt well despite believing he was ill.
questions.evidence: I felt perfectly well, and yet I knew I must be ill. I could not understand the complete absence of other symptoms.
questions.explanation: 结尾的幽默来自自认生病与身体感觉良好的矛盾；此历史讽刺文本不提供医学判断。
